messages:
customer-jones: Hi, we migrated to Redwood Private yesterday and started seeing intermittent 403s + big tail latency. Appears region routing sometimes sends requests to eu gateway even though our VPC is in us-west.

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste a couple of raw request IDs or a curl you used?

customer-jones: Sure, one sample req id `req_0x7f3b2a`. We tested with curl from their onprem NAT:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX' \
  -H 'X-Client-Region: us-west' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```
They get intermittent responses like: `{"error":"region_mismatch","message":"token not valid for selected region"}` and sometimes 200 but with 700ms latency.

maria_support: Hmm. Our control plane decides route based on SNI/Host + source IP affinity. If edge sees source IP belonging to eu egress pool it will prefer eu.

raj_netops: I pulled flow logs from their TGW. Their onprem egress appliance is doing SNAT -> 35.196.12.34 (a cloud NAT IP we previously gave to their partner peering). That IP is geolocated to europe and is in our EU-affinity table.

elena_oncall: Also their proxy is a transparent TCP proxy that adds a PROXY protocol header to upstream. That caused our edge TLS inspector to see client IP as the proxy IP from eu and ignore original X-Forwarded-For in some code paths.

maria_support: Can you drop the short log snippet of the request as seen at our edge for req_0x7f3b2a?

raj_netops: Snip from edge logs: 
```
[2109876543.512] req=req_0x7f3b2a src=35.196.12.34 dst=34.210.50.1 host=api.redwood.example.com sni=api.redwood.example.com routed_region=eu-west1 auth_region=us-west status=403 latency_ms=28
```
Note: status 403 because auth_region mismatched. But for other reqs where proxy didn't insert PROXY header we see 
```
src=203.0.113.129 routed_region=us-west1 status=200 latency_ms=710
```

maria_support: So two issues: (1) SNAT pools map customer to an IP that our routing table marks eu → wrong-region routing. (2) Transparent proxy + PROXY protocol makes our edge treat proxy IP as source so we prefer eu variant, but sometimes request reaches us with original src and we pick us-west causing inconsistent behavior and auth region mismatch.

elena_oncall: Repro steps I used:
1) On their appliance toggle proxy in transparent mode (adds PROXY proto) and send 10k requests. 20% hit eu, many 403s.
2) Disable PROXY header, keep SNAT -> almost all routed to us-west but latency spikes due to cross-AZ pathing the cloud NAT introduced.

maria_support: Could this also explain billing attribution issues? They reported tokens billed under EU tenant yesterday.

raj_netops: Yes. Billing attribution reads routed_region for usage tagging. When src IP maps to EU we bill against EU metering bucket. So overlap in SNAT IPs caused some usage to be charged to EU.

customer-jones: Oof. Can you propose a fix? This is affecting live traffic.

elena_oncall: Short-term mitigation: add an auto-fallback rule at edge to prefer auth_region header from token if present before using src-IP affinity. We can push a quick guard to reduce 403s.

maria_support: I'll open an expedite change. Longer-term: we need to update our region-affinity table and document that customers using onprem SNAT must avoid using IP ranges that overlap our regional egress pools. Also recommend disabling transparent PROXY OR use PROXY protocol with correct client IP preserved and ensure SNI isn't rewritten.

raj_netops: For this customer we removed the offending SNAT mapping (their appliance had a stale public IP assignment) + configured their proxy to pass PROXY protocol correctly so edge sees original client IP. After change we ran load test: 0% routed to EU, 403s gone, p95 latency improved to 120ms.

customer-jones: Confirmed — clients show auth success and billing looks back to us-west. Thanks.

maria_support: Filed internal postmortem + actions: 
- short-term edge guard: prefer token auth region over src-IP for routing (rollout 10m)
- update doc: private egress cookbook for SNAT + PROXY protocol (assign to eng-network)
- contact billing to reclassify affected window (support case #4201)

infra-bot: deploy started: edge-guard-region-priority v0.1 -> canary (2 nodes)

elena_oncall: Monitoring note: watch for increased latency during canary, but should reduce 403s.

customer-jones: Appreciate the quick response. Please keep me posted on billing reclassification.

maria_support: Will do. Closing thread after billing update. :thumbsup:
